rows.ticket_purpose: A client that cannot authenticate against a SASL listener surfaces somewhere a human looks, rather than only in the broker's own warnings.
rows.caller_or_flow: contract.yaml dependency injection and runtime_broker_auth_refusal.py: read/probe CLI; ticket AC-4 requires visible refusal readings.
rows.why_cannot_run: subscribe_topics=[]; metadata.transport_type=inmemory; constructor needs overlay, host, log source, appender and clock; no external source importer.
rows.recommendation_target: Proposed onex-broker-auth-refusal.timer on the declared monitoring host, every 5 minutes: python -m omnimarket.nodes.node_broker_auth_refusal_reading_effect read; install via the host installer; use its declared dev broker log source.

rows.ticket_purpose: a join check compares the values consumers depend on.
rows.caller_or_flow: contract.yaml:53 names a host timer and the node CLI; ticket Plan task cites beta/plans/2026-11-05-base-first-stopgap-plan.md 6.3 rule 13 (that plan file is not present in this host checkout).
rows.why_cannot_run: runtime_profiles=[]; subscribe_topics=[]; local transport and injected overlay/file source/environment/appender/clock; no external source importer.
rows.recommendation_target: Proposed onex-overlay-consumer-join.timer on the declared overlay-reading host, daily: python -m omnimarket.nodes.node_overlay_drift_compute daily; install through the host installer and preserve the existing consumer-join overlay.

rows.ticket_purpose: a compute node compares a runtime's booted node set with the deployment's declared boot set and returns a typed verdict naming missing and extra nodes
rows.caller_or_flow: contract.yaml runtime_dispatch and one-runtime plan beta/plans/2026-11-01-one-runtime-plan.md:492, T28; no boot-observation producer invokes this handler in the inspected sources.
rows.why_cannot_run: runtime_profiles=[]; subscribe_topics=[]; local direct invocation needs declaration, catalog and observed boot; no external source importer.
rows.recommendation_target: Proposed dev boot-completion verification flow for one-runtime T28 calls HandlerRuntimeBootSet with the deployment overlay, announced catalog and actual attached contracts/subscriptions; main profile for a bus adapter on the declared boot-set-judge command, once per completed dev boot.

rows.ticket_purpose: An orchestrator node picks the validators that apply to a change from contracts, then runs the read effects, the compute nodes and the emit and gate effects.
rows.caller_or_flow: contract.yaml:4-10 and dependency_ownership: caller constructs real change reader, contract source, reducer, emitter and gate; adapters/two_backend.py:220 has make_real_backend; source ticket names the validator workflow.
rows.why_cannot_run: subscribe_topics=[]; metadata.transport_type=inmemory; default backend in_memory; constructor dependencies supplied only by its adapters; no external source importer.
rows.recommendation_target: Proposed pull-request head-change workflow caller builds the real adapters and sends the declared validator-workflow-requested command; effects profile on a dependency-injecting runtime adapter. Keep node_validator_verdict_reducer called in process by this workflow.

rows.ticket_purpose: The hourly check sends its list to the shared message system, the status page reads it from there
rows.caller_or_flow: contract.yaml runtime_dispatch: hourly integration pass pipes ModelIntegrationReadingBatch on stdin to python -m omnimarket.nodes.node_integration_reading_publish_effect --home; the current INTEGRATION_PASS_TICK_PROMPT does not invoke this publisher.
rows.why_cannot_run: subscribe_topics=[]; CLI composes the projection compute and publisher; graph has no external source importer; the declared hourly prompt does not yet call the typed batch publisher.
rows.recommendation_target: Hourly integration-pass writer at cron 37 * * * * calls the existing publisher CLI with the typed JSON batch after its ledger rewrite; schedule on the launching host (not a new h201 subscription), using its declared projection publisher overlay.
